text: Whether it is better: Heb. What is good? whether, etc
by the plain of the pillar: Or, by the oak of the pillar. See Jos_24:26
go to be promoted over the trees?: Or, go up and down for other trees
adventured his life: Heb. cast his life
aided him in the killing: Heb. strengthened his hands to kill
privily: Heb. craftily or to Tormah
as thou shalt find: Heb. as thine hand shall find
middle: Heb. navel | Meonenim: Or, the regarders of times
me do: Heb. I have done
